text: Now let me run the existing test suite and a quick self-check of the new features:

arguments.command:
python - <<'EOF'
import semver
from semver import VersionInfo as V

# R1
v = V(1, 2, 3, 'rc.1', 'build.4')
for attr in ('major','minor','patch','prerelease','build'):
    try:
        setattr(v, attr, 99)
        print('R1 FAIL', attr)
    except AttributeError:
        pass

# R2
print('R2', list(v), list(v) == [1,2,3,'rc.1','build.4'])

# R3
assert v == (1,2,3,'rc.1','build.4')
assert v < (2,0,0,None,None)
assert (1,2,3,'rc.1','build.4') == v
for bad in ("1.2.3", 1, 1.5):
    try:
        v > bad
        print('R3 FAIL no TypeError for', type(bad))
    except TypeError:
        pass
print('R3 ok')

# R4
print('R4', V(3,4,5).bump_major(), V(3,4,5).bump_minor(), V(3,4,5).bump_patch())
print('R4p', V(3,4,5).bump_prerelease(), V(3,4,5,'rc.1').bump_prerelease())
print('R4b', V(3,4,5).bump_build(), V(3,4,5,'rc.1','build.9').bump_build())

# R5
w = V("1","2","3", 456, 789)
print('R5', type(w.major).__name__, type(w.minor).__name__, type(w.patch).__name__, repr(w.prerelease), repr(w.build))

# R6
p = semver.createparser()
print('R6 prog', p.prog, callable(semver.main), callable(semver.process))

# R7
print('R7', semver.replace('1.2.3-rc.1+build.4', major=2, build='x'))
print('R7v', v.replace(major=2, prerelease=None))

# existing module behavior
print('module', semver.bump_patch('3.4.5-rc1+build4'), semver.compare('1.0.0','2.0.0'), semver.max_ver('1.0.0','2.0.0'))
EOF
